Code blocks inside list items now draw as code blocks: desk-look reads Markdown blocks with marked's lexer instead of its own line parser.

- A fenced block indented under a bullet (for example a ```diff under "- fixed a.kt") draws as a code box inside that item. Before, its lines ran into the bullet's text and diff `-` lines turned into sub-bullets
- List items can hold paragraphs, code blocks, quotes and nested lists, in the transcript, the preview pane and the browser page (`o`)
- Markdown follows CommonMark more closely: `Title` over `---` is a heading, a line indented four spaces after a blank line is code, a line that continues a list item without indent stays in that item, and a numbered list right after a bulleted one is a separate list
- Command output with indented lines (such as `git log`) still shows as plain text; only tables, headings, fenced code and quotes make it Markdown
- Parsed blocks are kept for recently drawn text, so redrawing a long transcript does not parse it again
- desk-asana task descriptions and comments and desk-slack messages draw the same way
- `hooks/vendor/marked.js` is marked 18.2.0 (MIT), only its lexer, bundled without minification from its TypeScript source. It runs no programs and makes no requests
- desk-plan and desk-review move to 0.77.0 with no changes

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
